messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **long weekends** that Canadians enjoyed in 2023.  
A “long weekend” is defined as a holiday that falls on a Friday or a Monday (or is observed on the nearest weekday when it lands on a weekend), giving you a three‑day break that includes the weekend.

| Date(s) | Holiday | Notes |
|---------|---------|-------|
| **Jan 1–2** | New Year’s Day (observed Jan 2) | Jan 1 was a Sunday; the holiday was observed on Monday, giving a 2‑day weekend (Sunday–Monday). |
| **Apr 7–9** | Good Friday (and Easter Monday in some provinces) | Good Friday is a statutory holiday in many provinces and for federal employees. It creates a 3‑day weekend (Friday–Sunday). |
| **May 22–24** | Victoria Day | Celebrated on the Monday preceding May 25. Gives a 3‑day weekend (Monday–Wednesday). |
| **Jul 1–3** | Canada Day (observed Jul 3) | July 1 was a Saturday; the holiday was observed on Monday, giving a 3‑day weekend (Saturday–Monday). |
| **Sep 4–6** | Labour Day | First Monday in September. 3‑day weekend (Monday–Wednesday). |
| **Oct 9–11** | Thanksgiving | Second Monday in October. 3‑day weekend (Monday–Wednesday). |
| **Nov 11–13** | Remembrance Day (observed Nov 13) | Nov 11 was a Saturday; observed on Monday, giving a 3‑day weekend (Saturday–Monday). |
| **Dec 25–27** | Christmas Day (observed Dec 25) | Dec 25 was a Monday; gives a 3‑day weekend (Monday–Wednesday). |

### Provincial “Long Weekend” Add‑Ons (2023)

| Province | Holiday | Date | Long Weekend? |
|----------|---------|------|---------------|
| Alberta, British Columbia, Ontario, Saskatchewan | Family Day | Feb 20 (Monday) | Yes |
| Manitoba | Louis Riel Day | Feb 20 (Monday) | Yes |
| New Brunswick | Family Day | Feb 20 (Monday) | Yes |
| Newfoundland & Labrador | St. Patrick’s Day | Mar 17 (Friday) | Yes |
| Nova Scotia | Family Day | Feb 20 (Monday) | Yes |
| Prince Edward Island | Family Day | Feb 20 (Monday) | Yes |
| Quebec | Saint‑Jean‑Baptiste Day | Jun 24 (Friday) | Yes |
| Yukon | Heritage Day | Sep 4 (Monday) | Yes |

> **Tip for your app:**  
> - Use the federal holiday list for a baseline.  
> - Add provincial holidays where relevant to the user’s location.  
> - Remember that holidays falling on a weekend are usually observed on the nearest weekday (Monday if Saturday, Tuesday if Sunday).  

Feel free to let me know if you’d like the data in a different format (JSON, CSV, etc.) or if you need the same information for another year!
